title: Pure Monarch
summary: The True Monarch build with generic staples and a full Extra Deck of generic Link Monsters. Domain of the True Monarchs only stops the opponent's Extra Deck while yours is empty, so here it is played for its Level reduction and ATK boost. The 2025 cards lead. Eidos the Underworld Monarch searches a Monarch Spell/Trap or a 2800/1000 Monarch when summoned and comes back from the GY whenever you Tribute Summon a Monarch. The Monarchs Masterplan sends a Monarch Spell/Trap to the GY, and when banished it searches a 2400/1000 Monarch with the Attribute of one of their monsters and Normal Summons it; Eidos can change that Attribute first. Edea and Eidos the Underworld Squire give the extra bodies and Tribute Summons, and Ehther and Erebus send Monarch Spells/Traps to summon or recycle. Emperor of the Land and Sea, The Monarchs Revolt and Monarchic Perfection are not out in the TCG yet.

main: Eidos the Underworld Monarch
Newest card: searches a Monarch Spell/Trap or a 2800/1000 Monarch; returns when you Tribute Summon.
Edea the Heavenly Squire
Summons an 800/1000 Squire from the Deck; recovers a banished Monarch Spell/Trap.
Eidos the Underworld Squire
Grants an extra Tribute Summon; from the GY, revives an 800/1000 Squire.
Ehther the Heavenly Monarch
Sends two Monarch Spells/Traps to summon a big Monarch from the Deck; Tribute Summons on their turn.
Erebus the Underworld Monarch
Shuffles away one of their cards; recovers a Monarch from the GY.
Caius the Mega Monarch
Banishes up to two cards when Tribute Summoned with a DARK.
The Monarchs Masterplan
Newest Spell: mills a Monarch Spell/Trap; banished, searches and Normal Summons a 2400/1000 Monarch.
Pantheism of the Monarchs
Discards a Monarch Spell/Trap to draw 2; from the GY, searches one.
Tenacity of the Monarchs
Reveals a Monarch to search a Monarch Spell/Trap.
Domain of the True Monarchs

Return of the Monarchs
Searches a Monarch every time you Tribute Summon.
The Prime Monarch
